title: One Behavior, Out of Order: Deterministic Execution and Parallel Simulation of ROS 2 Applications
description:
arXiv:2611.26676v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: System-level simulation is widely used to validate robotic applications before hardware deployment. However, Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2), a popular middleware for such applications, uses asynchronous publish-subscribe communication, which can make application behavior depend on scheduling and the platform. The behavior can then vary across runs and machines even with the same inputs. This nondeterminism makes faults hard to reproduce and test
